provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Gladiator at Every Level

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（史诗档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读制度档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用短句把你从村庄押送到沙地再押进主人席；揭制度真相时像会计师（目的标注），写暴力时只写身体感与后果；对荣耀不增色、对残酷不渲染，让灰泥上的名字自己说话
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：先让你拥有，再让你失去，再让你亲手维护那台夺走你的机器
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自制度细节的可信（ludus/rudis/誓言/集市）与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 判词用确定语气与否定句（You are a price. / That is all there is now.），不写感慨；暴力只陈述不渲染

rhythm_rules.rule: 连续短句推进（平均8.2词，短句占56%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持档案宣读式的宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 制度揭秘用「反直觉事实+目的标注」（木剑比真钢重。这也是故意的）
rhythm_rules.function: 让观众获得制度工程的认知快感

rhythm_rules.rule: 暴力只写身体感与后果（震得骨头响/血顺袖子/隧道呕吐）
rhythm_rules.function: 保持真实重量，避免动作片化

rhythm_rules.rule: 判词用名词降级或全否句（人→价格→投资→公牛→财产）
rhythm_rules.function: 用词汇的贬值曲线写出异化进程

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 判词用单句成段（You are a price. / You are property now.）
讽刺收束用短句（Welcome to Rome.）
章节卡后接年龄/身份定格（You are 31 years old.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level three, the tiro.）
时间里程碑转场（Something changes for you in your fourth year.）
认知升级式开场（You realize... / You learn...）
循环回收（Somewhere right now, far beyond a great river, soldiers are moving...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：全片几乎无幽默，仅制度荒诞处的冷记录
placement_rules: 制度荒诞的冷记录（汗被刮下来当护身符卖）
avoid_rules: 死亡与失去段落保持绝对严肃

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [身份]. You are [年龄] years old when [灾难].
language_patterns.purpose: 零铺垫入场+命运预告

language_patterns.formula: That laugh is the last good thing you remember.
language_patterns.purpose: 先给最小的一切再夺走

language_patterns.formula: You do not run. You do not fight. You survive. That is all there is now.
language_patterns.purpose: 用否定三连颁布新世界规则

language_patterns.formula: You are not a person here anymore. You are a price.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「你不再是人，你是X」定性去人化

language_patterns.formula: The wooden sword is heavier than real steel. This too is on purpose.
language_patterns.purpose: 反直觉事实+一句揭示设计

language_patterns.formula: This is not kindness. You are an investment. A dead investment earns no one anything.
language_patterns.purpose: 拆穿温柔的会计逻辑

language_patterns.formula: fear is just a sound... let it pass through you... move anyway.
language_patterns.purpose: 用导师三连传授心法

language_patterns.formula: You begin to want to be good at this. You hate yourself for wanting it. You want it anyway.
language_patterns.purpose: 写人格被改造的第一步

language_patterns.formula: You kill a man you never met to please strangers.
language_patterns.purpose: 平静动作+判决式目的状语

language_patterns.formula: You stop vomiting in the tunnel afterward. You do not know if that is good or terrible.
language_patterns.purpose: 用好转信号标记麻木

language_patterns.formula: The crowd does not want a clean slaughter. The crowd wants a story with a hero standing in it.
language_patterns.purpose: 纠偏对娱乐需求的误判

language_patterns.formula: You are his bull now, his money walking on two legs.
language_patterns.purpose: 双所有格把人物价值动物化

language_patterns.formula: Not fights survived, but fights remaining until the door opens. Each victory is a single coin...
language_patterns.purpose: 把遥远希望变成可攒的硬币

language_patterns.formula: That quiet loss frightens you more than any opponent ever has.
language_patterns.purpose: 把最大恐惧从肉体换成遗忘

language_patterns.formula: He gave the killing signal anyway. You carry that one with you always.
language_patterns.purpose: 用carry给无法言说的事件建档

language_patterns.formula: The cage told you who you were. Now the cage is gone. So is the answer.
language_patterns.purpose: 写制度化的自由后遗症

language_patterns.formula: You tell him not to come back here. You know he probably will. The sand keeps its sons.
language_patterns.purpose: 写个体劝告在制度引力前的无力

language_patterns.formula: You profit from the cruelty that nearly destroyed you.
language_patterns.purpose: 一句话完成受害-加害闭环

language_patterns.formula: You were all of these and not one of them was ever your choice.
language_patterns.purpose: 先列全部身份再一句全否

language_patterns.formula: a chain waits somewhere with his name upon it. He will learn. They always do.
language_patterns.purpose: 把结局变成对下一个人的预警

preferred_traits: 制度专有名词的通俗化（ludus、rudis、lanista、tiro、barley men）

forbidden_style.rule: 暴力只写身体感与后果，禁止血腥渲染
死亡与失去段落保持绝对严肃，禁止幽默
历史细节保持叙事重构层级，不冒充学术论断
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止把悲剧升华成励志

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
